// Actually implement selu: output = max(0, input) * sigmoid(input)
// We'll write a separate kernel for SELU:
__global__ void selu_kernel_f32(const float* input, float* output, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        float x = input[idx];
        // SELU: max(0, x) * sigmoid(x)
        float y = torch::sigmoid(x);
        output[idx] = std::max(0.0f, x) * y;
    }
}

    const int block_size = 256;
